title: POAG  European GWAS eCAVIAR colocalization results
bodyHtml: This table contains the significant eCAVIAR colocalization results for primary open-angle glaucoma (POAG) European (EUR) GWAS loci (Gharahkhani et al., 2021) by QTL type, target gene, and tissue combinations tested across 49 GTEx tissues and peripheral retina. All e/sVariants within an LD interval (r2<0.1 plus 50kb on either side) around 68 lead GWAS variants were tested in the colocalization analysis. Significance was determined at colocalization posterior probability (CLPP) > 0.01. To filter out potential false positives, we flagged cases where the GWAS p-value of the colocalization e/sVariant was above 1E-05 and/or whose e/sQTL p-value was above 1E-04 or FDR above 0.05 (FALSE in Column: 'Pass QC (QTL FDR<0.05 or P<1E04 and GWAS P<1E05)). Chromosome positions are in genome build 38. The table was taken from Supplementary Data 8 in Hamel et al., 2024.
